title: Model structures on the category of Q-shaped modules
summary: We develop a method for constructing abelian model structures on the category Q,AMod of Q-shaped modules from cotorsion pairs in AMod, where Q is a small preadditive category satisfying certain conditions and AMod denotes the category of left A-modules for any ring A. More precisely, we construct two cotorsion pairs in Q,AMod from a given cotorsion pair in AMod. This leads to a construction of projective model structures on Q,AMod under the condition that Q has no cycles.
